import robot

# Move TCP to the center of the blue cube to place it first
blue_center = [0.413958, 0.132719, 0.019957]
robot.move_to(blue_center)

# Open gripper and pick up the red cube
red_center = [0.402435, -0.129157, 0.019957]
robot.gripper(closed=False)

# Move to the center of the red cube (slightly higher for grasping)
red_grasp_point = [0.402435, -0.129157, 0.06]
robot.move_to(red_grasp_point)

# Close gripper to pick up the red cube
robot.gripper(closed=True)

# Move to a transfer height above the blue cube and place the red cube on top
transfer_height = 0.24
place_point = [blue_center[0], blue_center[1], transfer_height]
robot.move_to(place_point)

# Release the red cube on the blue cube
robot.gripper(closed=False)

# Move away from the stack to finish
robot.jog("x", 0.05)
